No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you understand historic astronomical instruments through observed form and function.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Orientation and basic sky geometry
  • Selected major instruments
  • Observation challenges and limitations
  • Historical astronomy in context

How the time is spent

  1. Orientation and basic sky geometry 25 min

  2. Selected major instruments 45 min

  3. Observation challenges and limitations 45 min

  4. Historical astronomy in context 35 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.

Where
Jaipur, Rajasthan
For
Individuals, families, schools, colleges, private groups and visitors from abroad

Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
